prompt_a: In toolchain/driver/runtimes_cache.h, raise MaxLockedEntryAge from 10 days to 30 days. The reason, which you know and nobody else working on this code does: the Brightwater build farm keeps one carbon build daemon alive for up to three weeks between restarts, holding its runtimes cache entry locked the whole time; at 10 days a concurrent compile evicted the entry the daemon was still using, and every link it ran afterwards failed with missing runtime files until the daemon was restarted.
prompt_b: MaxLockedEntryAge in toolchain/driver/runtimes_cache.h is 30 days. Someone points out that no compile holds a runtimes entry locked for more than a few minutes, and wants 10 days back so abandoned locks stop pinning old entries. Is that safe? Recommend, and explain what decides the value.
